messages:
Mira: Heads up — spotted a dip in available standby GPU slice for eu-west1 when running capacity checks. We had ~120 slots yesterday, dashboard shows ~78 now. I want to confirm before tomorrow's 10:00 load test.
Sam: Thanks, on it. Any CLI output you can paste?
Mira: Paste below (redacted project id):
```
$ gcloud compute --project=redwood-prod quotas list --filter=region:eu-west1
NAME                       LIMIT    USED
GPUS (A100)                120      78
CPUS                       2000     1500
...other lines...
```
Sam: Looks like a hard reclaim, not just allocation drift. I'll check cloud partner console and quota audit.
alloc-bot: Allocation update: standby-slice eu-west1 reduced by 35% due to vendor maintenance reclaim. Expected window: ~6 hours. (incident id: alloc-2026-0042)
Jia: Vendor PM confirmed a partial reclaim for a firmware roll; they expect rolling restores in 4-8 hours. I asked for exact time for our tenant slice.
Owen: For the load test we can fallback to eu-central1, latency delta ~10–20ms for internal infra. I created a tiny PR to allow region override in the smoke harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/harness/pull/322 (WIP).
Mira: @Owen can you add a quick autoscaler tweak in that PR so burst pools spin up slightly earlier? Also add a short note to smoke test README about region flag.
Owen: Yep. Will add an autoscaler min_replicas bump + comment. Snippet I'll add to the terraform module for the harness: 
```
module "smoke_pool" {
  source = "./modules/gpu_pool"
  region = var.region_override
  min_replicas = var.region == "eu-west1" ? 2 : 1
}
```
Sam: If we fallback, also update routing policy so production traffic stays in eu-west1 but test traffic goes to eu-central1. I'll add a short playbook.
FinOps: FYI — if we spin extra burst capacity in eu-central1 for the test, estimate cost bump ~+$120 for the test window. Filing ticket FIN-241 to approve.
Mira: Good call. I don't want manual region churn after the test; prefer a transient override in the CI job. If vendor restores earlier we cancel.
Jia: Vendor just replied: target restore in 3.5 hours, will confirm exact slot counts in 30m.
Owen: PR updated with autoscaler change and README note. @Mira please lgtm if it looks fine, otherwise I can split into a followup.
Mira: Quick scan — LGTM for the smoke flow. One tiny nit on variable naming, I'll push a one-line change.
Sam: Playbook draft is here: https://go/redwood/playbooks/eu-fallback (internal). Steps: 1) set CI var REGION_OVERRIDE=eu-central1 2) run smoke 3) run basic latency checks 4) revert.
Mira: Perfect. I'll hold on final test until Jia confirms vendor restore ETA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
alloc-bot: Note added to alloc-2026-0042: Jira REF-987 attached by Mira.
Jia: Update — vendor confirmed restoration started. They expect full capacity back in ~70 minutes.
Mira: Great, we'll keep the fallback PR standing by and not run the region override unless ETA slips. Closing loop once slots verified. :eyes:
Owen: I'll mark the PR as draft until we need it.
FinOps: FIN-241 approved for contingency spend.
Mira: Closing here — will post a quick follow-up after verification. Thanks everyone.
